message: Verified entry requirements are not available for this route yet. Check the destination’s official immigration authority before booking.
notes: Your Nigeria passport is separate from your departure country. Official requirements must match your traveler details.

checklist.title: Check your passport
checklist.detail: Confirm the expiry date, blank pages, and destination-specific validity rules.

checklist.title: Confirm visa or travel authorisation
checklist.detail: Check the official rules for your passport, residence, purpose, and length of stay. Apply if required.

checklist.title: Check your connection
checklist.detail: Review transit requirements in United Kingdom, including whether you pass border control or change airports.

checklist.title: Review health and entry formalities
checklist.detail: Check official health guidance and any arrival declarations for your dates.

checklist.title: Review insurance and travel advisories
checklist.detail: Read destination advisories and confirm that your insurance covers your itinerary and activities.

checklist.title: Prepare your departure documents
checklist.detail: Keep your required approvals, booking details, and airline document checklist accessible.

checklist.title: Check your return journey
checklist.detail: Confirm your documents and permission to re-enter your country of residence.
